name: KVK Handelsregister Open Dataset Basisbedrijfsgegevens
licence: CC BY 4.0, with a ban on enrichment traceable to a person
reason: Anonymised: no KVK number, no name, postcode to two digits only, BV and NV only. Cannot identify businesses.

name: KVK Handelsregister Open Dataset Jaarrekeningen
licence: CC BY 4.0, with a ban on enrichment traceable to a person
notes: Anonymised (no name, KVK number or address), but has SBI code and financial statements: usable for sector distributions of turnover and margins, not for named companies.

name: KVK Handelsregister APIs (Zoeken, Basisprofiel, Vestigingsprofiel)
access: paid: EUR 6.40 per month; Zoeken free per call; profiles EUR 0.02 per call
reason: Costs money; the author ruled no spending on this use case (S06-014). Would have given names, SBI, headcount, BAG ID and websites per establishment.

name: KVK public website search
notes: Intended for building the hand-checked answer key for a sample, not for bulk use.

name: Basisregistratie Adressen en Gebouwen (BAG)
notes: Address backbone; licence not yet recorded.

name: DUO open onderwijsdata: addresses of boards (bevoegd gezag)
notes: Header verified: includes KVK-NUMMER. Less central after the theme changed to businesses (S06-011).

name: GLEIF Golden Copy (LEI records)
licence: CC0, with GLEIF terms against implied endorsement
notes: Carries the KVK number under registration authority RA000463, and addresses. Skews to larger firms and holdings.

name: ANBI register
notes: Keyed on fiscal number (RSIN), name, trading name and city only. Less central after the theme change.

name: Landelijk Register Kinderopvang (LRK) open data
access: open, CSV, twice weekly, with a history file
notes: Columns unverified: the CSV could not be fetched.

name: CBS StatLine 81644NED: establishments by size, legal form, sector, region
notes: Control totals per sector, size class and region.

name: Provinciaal Arbeidsplaatsen Register (PAR) 2024
licence: Public Domain Mark 1.0 per georegister metadata
access: open, form-based download; WFS disallowed to automated agents by robots.txt
reason: Download needs a person to use the form; the author has been asked to save the CSV under data/raw/par/. The province's page says only aggregated results are published, while the metadata describes establishment-level records; which is true is unsettled until the file is read.

name: Brookz business-for-sale listings
access: website; manual only, scraping presumed against terms
notes: About 1,100 national listings. Listing fields unverified. Proposed guard, not yet ruled: never match anonymised listings to named register entries.

name: OpenStreetMap, Geofabrik Utrecht province extract
notes: Not yet verified: the fetch hit the session limit (S06-016). Names, addresses, websites and business types; patchy for offices.

name: CBS turnover per employed person by sector
notes: Table not yet identified. Needed for turnover estimates as headcount times sector ratio.
